summary: Review enterprise trust/security pages as high-cost decision artifacts with claim provenance, scope, certification wording and implementation boundaries.

must_inspect.why: Security/compliance claims need explicit product, environment, certification and temporal scope.
false_positive_guards: Do not perform legal compliance determinations. Review only what the artifact communicates.

must_inspect.why: Implemented controls, audits, certifications and legal compliance are different claims with different proof burdens.
false_positive_guards: Do not upgrade a control statement into a certification claim.

must_inspect.why: High-cost enterprise decisions require a path to deeper evidence without forcing sensitive disclosure.
false_positive_guards: Do not require public disclosure of sensitive security details.
Do not reproduce secrets or confidential control details.
